_what: Duplicates that already exist in the catalog and are accepted for now, so old data debt does not block a new price update. Anything NOT listed here is a regression: audit_catalog.py reports it as CRITICAL, which makes Agent 3 roll back instead of pushing.
_status: EMPTY, and it should stay that way. The 11 Aug 2026 merge cleaned every entry that was here.
_history: Agent 3 reads catalog.ts in chunks and each chunk decides independently whether a device is missing. On 15 Jul 2026 (commit 82b2ba6) two chunks each concluded the Huawei Pura 90s Pro pair was missing and each added it, landing those devices in the Huawei block twice and in the Honor and Xiaomi blocks as well. The same fault shape had been cleaned by hand five days earlier (766e09b). Merged 11 Aug 2026 via scripts/merge_catalog_duplicates.mjs.
_if_you_are_about_to_add_an_entry: Don't, unless you have to. An entry here means the app is shipping a known-broken catalog shape: duplicate brand+model produces duplicate React keys, React cannot unmount the old search rows, and ghost results get pinned above every search. Fix the data instead. If a merge needs a pricing decision it must go to George — the Pura 90s Pro copies disagreed on Zerolution MP69 and the safe reading (NA on the entry tier) was chosen deliberately, not by script.
